meta.description:
Shows about the worlds of science, technology and knowledge. Prepare to be taken on a factual adventure!

Shows: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Stalin's Atomic Bunker", Cold War: The Tech Race S1 - "Information Is Power", How the Universe Works S2 - "Frozen Wanderers", Ocean Vet S1 - "The Bermuda Turtle Project", Ocean Vet S1 - "The Sixgill Shark"
Available on: Samsung TV Plus, Plex
